title: AMD security advisory (AV26-813)
description: As of August 11, 2026, AMD is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
AMD Power Design Manager (PDM) Software Installer for Windows
	all except 2026.1

AMD Power Design Manager (PDM) Software Un-Installer
	all except 2026.1

AMD Ryzen Master
	all except 3.0.0.4199
all except 3.1.1.5502

AMD Ryzen Master (AMD Ryzen 3000 Series Processors)
	all except 2.14.3.5040

AMD Ryzen Master Monitoring SDK
	all except 3.1.1.5478

AMD Ryzen Master SDK
	all except 3.0.1.4732

Vitis Libraries - Security Module
	all except 2026.1

Vitis Embedded Single File Download (SFD) for Windows
	all except 2026.1

Vitis Unified Installer for FPGAs & Adaptive SoCs in Windows
	all except 2026.1
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
